h1: Interior design project for an apartment in Bratislava with a total area of 58 m²

blocks.text: Interior design project for an apartment in Bratislava with a total area of 58 m²

parts.html: A 58 m² apartment in Bratislava. We handled the full cycle: an interior design project with 3D visualization, technical drawings, custom furniture, turnkey renovation, and decorating. Before the renovation, the client received a detailed cost estimate covering construction and finishing work, materials, furniture, and appliances. The gallery shows visualizations of the apartment.

The project includes a living room with a kitchen, a bedroom with a walk-in closet, an entrance hall, and a combined bathroom. The cabinets and shelves are sized for each zone, so there is enough room for belongings and the rooms stay uncluttered.

blocks.text: Entrance hall, living room and kitchen

parts.html: The entrance hall flows into the living room without a wall. A partition marks the boundary: black metal posts with a light marble-look panel in the center. It screens the sofa from the entrance but lets the light from the windows through. The entrance hall has a bench on a metal base, a wall-mounted coat rail, and a cabinet with gray fronts.

Two walls are clad in light gray brick-look tiles, the floor is wood-look, and the windows have wide blinds. The TV wall combines a marble-look panel with a dark niche, and under the TV is a floating media unit lit from below. The kitchen is dark gray, with wooden upper cabinets and built-in appliances. In front of the kitchen is a wooden breakfast bar, with a pendant on thin brass rods above it.

In the bedroom, the wall behind the bed is covered with soft gray upholstered panels with beveled seams. Below them, a wooden shelf runs the full width and serves as both headboard and bedside tables. Black lamps hang on either side. Opposite the bed are a TV and a floating console. A black metal shelving partition separates the walk-in closet from the bedroom.

In the hallway by the bedroom is a floor-to-ceiling wardrobe with walnut-look fronts and a profile handle along the edge. The bathroom is finished in gray stone-look tile, with one wall in wood-look tile lit from above. There is a wall-hung toilet, a countertop basin on a dark vanity, and a glass partition. We make cabinet furniture at our own production facility in Bratislava — kitchens, wardrobes, vanities.
